faq_heading: Chilliwack condos under $600,000: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Chilliwack condos sell for under $600,000?
faq.a: 219 of 253, or 87%. A further 27 sold in the next range up, $600,000 to $799,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a condo in Chilliwack?
faq.a: $370,000 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $600,000 is above the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $290,000 and $435,000.

faq.q: Which Chilliwack area has the lowest condo prices?
faq.a: Chilliwack Proper East, at $258,250 across 22 sales at $328 a square foot, median year built 1992. The highest of the 8 lowest was Garrison Crossing at $491,500.

faq.q: How fast do Chilliwack condos sell?
faq.a: 31 days at the median, closing at 96.8% of the last list price, with 3% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $600,000).
In Chilliwack, 219 of the 253 condos (87%) sold under $600,000. The median was $370,000, with the middle half between $290,000 and $435,000. The busiest price range, under $600,000, had 219 sales.

blocks.text: Buying a condo under $600,000 in Chilliwack

In Chilliwack Proper East the median condo sold for $258,250 across 22 sales, $341,750 under $600,000. Across Chilliwack the median condo took 31 days to sell and closed at 96.8% of the last list price, with 3% of the 253 sales above list. Check the strata fee and depreciation report.
